config_dir.description: Set the config directory location (matches -c/--config). If empty, the default location is used.

user_interface.description: Alternative UI to launch (e.g., 'gtk', 'web', 'console'). See deluge -h for available user interfaces.

user_interface_args.description: Optional arguments for the UI (matches [ui-args] in man page). E.g., '--listen-port=8112'.

logfile.description: Output to specified logfile instead of stdout (matches -l/--logfile).

loglevel.description: Set the log level (default is error). Values: none, info, warning, error, debug (matches -L/--loglevel).

quiet.description: Sets the log level to none, same as -L none (matches -q/--quiet).

logrotate.description: Enable logfile rotation, with optional maximum logfile size, default: 2M. (Logfile rotation count is 5). Matches --logrotate[=max-size].

profile.description: Profile with cProfile. Outputs to stdout unless a filename is specified. Matches --profile[=file].
